title: Diagnostic Imaging Equipment Service Contract
content: Comprehensive Medical Equipment Maintenance Agreement with Siemens Healthineers: 3-year service contract for two 3.0T MRI imaging systems and 64-slice CT scanners located at Central Medical Pavilion. Total 3-year contract value: $275,000.00. Annualized service fee: $91,666.67. Quarterly scheduled preventative maintenance included.
